thread:
Rhea: Quick heads-up 10: I'm starting a small run to align wording across the docs for the upcoming SDK release. Main focuses: voice/tone consistency, canonical names in glossary, and updating all SDK snippets + quickstarts. I'll try to keep PRs small.
Owen: +1. Can we lock down a single authoritative mappings file (CSV or md) so automation can consume it? Also would be great to include a light note on when to use Capitalized Product Names vs code identifiers.
Rhea: Yes 10: mappings will be at /docs/glossary/canonical_terms.csv. It will be lowercase keys for searchability. I'll add a short README that explains Capitalization rules: marketing/docs copy -> Title Case for product names; code/config -> snake_case or camelCase as appropriate.
Marta: For voice/tone, let's avoid "we recommend" in API reference, use neutral imperative: "Use X to Y". In tutorials keep conversational voice. I'll draft a 2-paragraph style note and drop into docs/style/voice.md.
Victor: Found a few broken links in quickstarts referencing /sdk/old-snippets. I can patch those in a follow-up PR once mappings land. Also flagged some examples that use `best-effort endpoint` phrase 10 we should map that to `fallback route` everywhere.
Rhea: Good catch. Mappings will include this row: `best-effort endpoint, fallback route`. Also including `model family, model line` and `dedicated_capacity, dedicated`.
cli-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/534 1 labels: docs, glossary, needs-review
Owen: For reviewers: please check examples under /docs/quickstarts, /docs/guides, and the sdk snippets folder. I can add a CI grep job that runs only against changed files to speed up feedback.
Marta: Suggest adding a tiny unit check: docs/tests/test_no_deprecated_terms.py that fails if any deprecated token appears in changed files. Keeps regressions small.
Rhea: I'll include a "How to validate" section in the PR with these commands so reviewers can reproduce locally:
```bash
# preview deprecated token matches
rg --hidden --glob '!node_modules' -n "model_family|dedicated_capacity|best-effort endpoint" docs || true
# run the mapping preview tool (doesn't apply changes)
python tools/term_swap.py --preview --terms docs/glossary/canonical_terms.csv --paths docs sdk
```
Victor: Can you also include clear guidance for docs writers: when to use product Capitalization (e.g., "Dedicated" vs `dedicated`) and when to use hyphenation? There was some back-and-forth on "rollout policy" vs "roll-out policy" last quarter.
Rhea: I'll add a short section in voice.md: prefer no hyphen for compound nouns used as labels (use "rollout policy"). For adjectives before nouns in prose, still no hyphen unless it reduces ambiguity.
Owen: For the SDK snippet updates: please split changes into two commits max: (1) tooling + tests + mappings, (2) bulk snippet/text edits. That helps approvals.
Marta: I'll take responsibility for voice.md and the example language pass if someone adds me to the PR.
Victor: After merge, I suggest we create a tiny post-merge checklist: run `tools/term_swap.py --apply` in sdk/examples to prepare a PR in the SDK repo so examples stay aligned. I'll open that once the docs PR merges.
Rhea: Plan timeline: open PR today, reviews by Thu, merge by Fri EOD. If anything looks risky we'll split out the quickstarts into a separate follow-up.
cli-bot: CI queued: docs/test(quick) will run after PR updates.
Owen: One more thing 10 please include a short migration blurb listing the old->new field names for SDK users, e.g.:
```diff
- endpoint.create(name="demo", model_family="gpt-xx", dedicated_capacity=4)
+ endpoint.create(name="demo", model_line="gpt-xx", dedicated=4)
```
Rhea: Added to migration.md. Also included a compatibility window note: runtime will accept old names until 2026-08-31 (tagging product for confirmation).
Marta: LGTM. I'll start the voice pass once PR is up.
Victor: I'll queue the SDK example PR after docs merge and ping support for a short customer notice.
Rhea: Thanks team 10 will post the PR link and checklist now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/534 (checklist: mappings, voice.md, migration.md, tests, CI job).
